source_evidence: Day328~11:50 exact player 'Yes' accepts the offered review of existing partnership obligations, not an investment, signature, transfer of access, or separate action. Sornell voluntarily explains the association is responsible for its two storehouse leases and rented office, upkeep of its three cargo boats, ordinary wages and escort costs, outstanding freight settlements and purchases, and the inspection-information payments already described; he distinguishes association obligations from the member households' separate liabilities. These are the established business's operating categories, not newly booked expenses, quantified debts or independently verified current financial balances. Halvessa's prospective250gp exclusive-supply offer remains unsigned/unpaid, not an outstanding loan or obligation. No agreement has yet defined which existing obligations V would assume or the capital/profit share. Consistent with fixed keeper motive and promised exit stake in prep/dm-only/dm-ferry-setup.md @72d5bde0ab9d84d89fdc63f20cf9c7bfb63b1516, Sornell raises his own previously promised settlement on leaving the association: 'There is also the settlement I was promised when I leave. If a new partner comes in, I want that promise honored.' Harthvale responds that existing promises will stand, but says 'We can discuss the timing another day.' Sornell visibly stiffens and replies 'We have discussed the timing before.' This is newly played evidence of an unsettled internal obligation and friction, not a verified sum, due date, threat, resignation, defection, murder admission or evidence of coercion. Vaskel observes without promising a settlement. Cirren and Mara recognize the importance of the disagreement, Fenar attentive. Harthvale asks what V makes of the obligations. No extra check, financial figures invented, payment, agreement, recording/copying or original custody change; V chooses response. Desen not yet informed of Day328 findings.
